about: Case 161's batch: u6 tags the storm line, u8 rewords the tagged line, and u7 migrates it, all started by the comment under it. Added: u9, started by the writer's comment under the supply boat line, corrects the captain's name. All four are approved and u7 is pointed. The real Edit guard explains the storm line by the chain of u6's and u8's edits and raises writer-line-edited and brain-dump-status-tag on b1-u6 and writer-line-edited on b1-u8; it raises writer-line-edited on b1-u9. The three storm-line flags are on a line two of the run's units edited in turn, in one batch, so they go to the flags call although a comment started both units. u9's flag stands. verify-flags.json holds the three storm-line flags and the cut-down b1-u6 and b1-u8, and not u9's flag or b1-u9. The step is judging.
